architecture.text:
PART 1 — ARCHITECTURE SUMMARY (plain text, no markdown bold)

---

PRODUCT IDENTITY
- Headline: "Live SAIGE Demo"
- One-line pitch: "An AI-powered tool to help you understand and reduce your environmental impact."

---

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE
- The page is designed to get visitors to register their organization and receive an instant AI-generated ESG analysis. A secondary objective is to encourage exploration of pre-loaded demo organizations as a low-friction entry point for prospective enterprise customers.

---

INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE
- Section 1: Environment banner — alerts users this is a shared public sandbox that resets daily and warns against entering real organizational data.
- Section 2: Hero / registration prompt — headline, sub-pitch, and primary registration call to action with usage constraints noted (one analysis per email per day).
- Section 3: Pre-loaded demo organizations — three sample organizations (Bucknell University, Nexatek Manufacturing, ClearPath Energy Co.) displayed with sector labels, EIP scores, and framework badges (GRI, TCFD, STARS).
- Section 4: ESG analysis form — instructs the user to enter org name and industry to receive an instant EIP estimate and risk callouts, with a "Register My Organization" action.
- Section 5: Footer-level attribution — builder credit (VEU AI Studio) and demo domain (saigedemo.com).

---

CONTENT INVENTORY

Visible CTAs:
- "Book Enterprise Demo"
- "Explore in Full Sandbox"
- "Register My Organization"
- Navigation/header link implied by "Sandbox"

Visible forms or input affordances:
- Organization registration form accepting at minimum org name and email (implied by "1 analysis per email per day") and industry field.

Trust signals:
- Three pre-loaded demo organizations with realistic EIP scores (64–78) and recognized ESG framework badges: GRI, TCFD, STARS.
- Statement "Live backend · Real AI · Shared demo environment" indicating production-grade AI is running.
- Usage constraint framing ("1 analysis per email per day · No credit card · No account required") reduces friction and builds credibility.
- Builder attribution to VEU AI Studio with a dedicated demo domain (saigedemo.com).

---

TECH SIGNALS
- Page is JS-rendered (captured via browserless), indicating a modern SPA or SSR framework (likely React, Next.js, or similar).
- Separate demo domain (saigedemo.com) from marketing domain (saigeplatform.com), suggesting environment isolation between production and sandbox.
- "Live backend · Real AI" copy implies active API calls to an AI inference layer (likely LLM-based scoring) rather than static mock data.
- Daily data reset logic implies scheduled backend jobs or time-keyed database partitioning.
- No CDN, hosting provider, or build toolchain explicitly identifiable from the truncated body text alone.

---

ACCESSIBILITY SIGNALS
- Heading hierarchy is present and logical: h1 ("Live SAIGE Demo") followed by h2 ("Get your organization's ESG analysis"), which is correct two-level nesting.
- No alt-text presence can be confirmed from the body text; emoji characters (🌐, 🎓, 🏭, ⚡) are used as visual indicators for sections/cards, which may lack accessible labels for screen readers.
- Contrast indicators are not determinable from text content alone.
- Form field labels are described in prose ("Enter your org name and industry") but explicit label element usage is unverifiable from the capture.

---

QUALITY SCORE: 62/100
- The page is functionally clear and well-structured with a logical IA, multiple appropriate CTAs, and recognizable ESG trust signals, but its credibility is limited by reliance on a sandbox environment, unverifiable form accessibility, emoji-dependent iconography without confirmed alt-text, and an absence of third-party validation, customer logos, or quantified outcome claims.

---

improvement_plan.text:
PART 1 — IMPROVEMENT PLAN (plain text, no markdown bold)

---

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The single biggest opportunity is converting sandbox explorers into enterprise pipeline by strengthening the bridge between the demo experience and the "Book Enterprise Demo" CTA — currently that path is buried and unsupported by social proof, outcome data, or urgency. The single biggest risk is that the environment warning banner ("data is shared and reset daily — do not enter real organizational data") actively undermines trust at the exact moment a visitor is deciding whether to engage, and without mitigation it will cause high-intent prospects to abandon before reaching the registration form.

---

PRIORITIZED IMPROVEMENTS (max 7)

P0 | trust | Reframe the environment warning banner — the current banner leads with risk language ("do not enter real data") which primes visitors for distrust before they see any value; replace it with a positively framed sandbox assurance such as "Safe to explore — this is a dedicated demo environment using anonymized sample data" and move the data-sharing caveat to a secondary tooltip or footer note rather than the hero zone.

P0 | conversion | Elevate "Book Enterprise Demo" into a persistent, high-contrast CTA — the enterprise booking action is the highest commercial value event on the page but is currently treated as a peer to sandbox exploration; make it a sticky header button with a differentiating label such as "Get a Private Enterprise Demo" and add a one-line value qualifier beneath it ("custom data, private environment, dedicated CSM").

P1 | trust | Add quantified outcome claims and third-party validation — the page asserts AI-powered ESG analysis but offers no evidence of accuracy, methodology, or customer results; add at minimum one cited statistic (e.g., "organizations using SAIGE reduced reporting time by X%"), one recognized framework endorsement, or one named customer logo to anchor credibility before the registration form.

P1 | copy | Clarify what the EIP Score means before asking users to register — visitors are presented with EIP scores of 64–78 on the demo cards but are given no explanation of the scale, what constitutes a good score, or what the analysis will reveal for their own organization; add a single-sentence tooltip or inline explainer ("EIP Score: 0–100 scale measuring Environmental Impact Performance across GRI, TCFD, and STARS criteria") on each card and above the registration form.

P1 | conversion | Add a micro-conversion path for visitors not ready to register — the current page forces a binary choice between full registration and passive sandbox browsing with no middle option; introduce a "See a sample report" link that opens a pre-generated PDF or modal showing what the AI output looks like, reducing perceived commitment and accelerating trust.

P2 | compliance | Add accessible labels to all emoji-based icons and confirm form field label elements — the sector icons (🎓, 🏭, ⚡, 🌐) have no confirmed aria-label attributes, and the registration form fields are described only in prose rather than explicit label elements; add aria-label="Higher Education sector" style attributes to each emoji and audit form markup to ensure every input has a programmatically associated label element.

P2 | design | Introduce visual hierarchy differentiation between the three demo org cards and the registration form — currently both sections are described at the same content weight, which creates ambiguity about whether the user should explore cards first or register immediately; use a stepped visual layout (cards as step 1 "See what SAIGE does", form as step 2 "Try it for your org") with numbered step indicators to guide sequential engagement.

---

QUICK WINS (max 3)

Rewrite the environment warning banner copy from risk-first ("do not enter real data") to value-first ("Safe sandbox — explore freely, no real data required") — this is a single string change requiring no design or engineering work and directly reduces first-impression abandonment.

Add a one-sentence EIP Score explainer as static tooltip or parenthetical text on each demo org card — this is a copy-only addition that can be shipped in under 30 minutes and immediately increases comprehension of the core product metric.

Change the "Register My Organization" button label to "Get My Free ESG Analysis" — this is a single label change that shifts focus from the user's obligation (registering) to the user's reward (receiving analysis), and no design or engineering changes are required.

---

STRUCTURAL CHANGES (max 3)

Build a sample report modal or PDF preview — engineering work is required to either generate a static pre-filled report for a fictional organization or wire up a modal that renders the AI output format; this is the highest-leverage trust and conversion asset the page is missing and should be scoped as a 1–2 sprint deliverable with design and backend involvement.

Redesign the page layout as a guided two-step funnel — restructure the information architecture so that demo org card exploration (step 1) visually leads into the registration form (step 2) using a stepped or scroll-anchored layout, replacing the current flat parallel structure; this requires design and front-end engineering work but directly addresses the conversion drop-off between awareness and action.

Instrument the page with conversion event tracking and a post-registration email sequence — currently there is no confirmed analytics capture on CTA clicks, form starts, form completions, or sandbox exploration paths, and no mentioned follow-up after analysis delivery; adding event tracking (e.g., Segment or GA4 custom events) and a single post-analysis email with a "Ready for a private demo?" CTA requires both engineering and marketing ops work but closes the loop between the demo and the enterprise sales pipeline.

---

QUALITY SCORE: 74/100

The plan is grounded in a well-structured architecture summary with clear IA, CTA inventory, and identified trust gaps. Score is modestly capped because the underlying page capture is truncated at 8000 characters meaning visual design, actual form markup, color contrast, and full CTA placement cannot be independently verified, which introduces moderate uncertainty in the conversion and accessibility recommendations.

---
